items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first travel charge per contractor per invoice. One flat-rate charge at €81 is allowed.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers sealing material used in the like-for-like repair. One piece at €26 gives €26.
Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c) support like-for-like replacement of the failed indoor supply pipe. One metre at the full-cover rate gives €42.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers reinstating the insulation on the repaired section. One metre at the full-cover rate gives €26.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers distinct installer labour; §7.1.8(c) would exclude it if it duplicated the technician charge. The stated Installation prior gives 1 hour × €480.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers technician labour for the pipe repair. Case 39 supports €732 for the same nine-unit line.
Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) cover necessary drying and one equipment deployment charge per operation. One flat rate at the full-cover level gives €580.

items.description: Close and repaint the wall patch
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(a) cover making good the access opening and finishing the affected patch. One patch repair at the full-cover level gives €633.
Section 7.1.6 does not extend cover to the undamaged part of the wall because the original paint was still available; the patch is already covered by line 8. If allowed, 8 m² at €25/m² would be €200.

items.description: Repaint the other walls and ceiling
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5–7.1.6 exclude repainting separate, undamaged surfaces merely to match. If allowed, the single flat-rate line is estimated at €650.
